args.title: AC-1: Finishing from the overview shows a thank-you message
args.steps:
1. Sign in as standard_user with password secret_sauce|Login succeeds and the Products page is displayed
2. Click the first Add to cart button in the product list|Cart badge shows "1"
3. Click the cart icon|Your Cart page is displayed
4. Click Checkout|Checkout: Your Information page is displayed
5. Enter "Jane" in First Name, "Doe" in Last Name, "12345" in Zip/Postal Code|Fields are filled
6. Click Continue|Checkout: Overview page is displayed
7. Click Finish|The page displays "Thank you for your order!" (confirmation page shown)
